correctness.rationale: Exact conditional multinomial moments give the covariance and population threshold. The strict age variance is positive. Splitting the small-age integral gives the coefficient b^2 log(1/b)/(2π); a two-dimensional Bessel corner asymptotic gives 2^{-3/4} b^{-1/2} exp(-sqrt(2)b)/sqrt(π), and the mesoscopic formula follows. The submitted code passed 42 independent integral, sign and asymptotic assertions; numerical testing is not used as proof.

value.rationale: Disjoint opposite tails are negatively related at fixed clock age yet positively coupled by the shared random age. The exact competition creates a finite-population sign transition and a universal critical length a_N proportional to 1/sqrt(N log N), with the full covariance limit (c-π)/(4π). This is a motivated structural phase boundary for a physical common-reset gas, not an arbitrary finite computation.
